findings.title: Fallback locales are not guaranteed to be loaded outside of controller requests
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only called inside `ApplicationController#set_locale`. When `I18n.t` is invoked outside of a controller request (such as in Sidekiq background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, or tests), or when `I18n.t(key, locale: ...)` is called with an explicit locale, `I18n.translate` in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` only loads `config.locale` and never loads the fallback locales (`SiteSetting.default_locale` and `:en`). Because `I18n::Backend::Simple` has its automatic loading bypassed by `translate_accelerator.rb`, `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` will look up keys in unloaded fallback locales and return missing translation results instead of falling back.

findings.title: `@loaded_locales` mixes symbols and strings and is nil before `ensure_loaded!` or `reload!`
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` returns an array of symbols (and `I18n.locale` is a symbol), so `ensure_loaded!` populates `@loaded_locales` with symbols, whereas `SiteSetting.default_locale` / `current_user.effective_locale` can be strings or symbols depending on how `config.locale` is read. Additionally, if `I18n.t` is called before `ensure_loaded!` or `reload!` has ever been called (for example during boot or in a job), `@loaded_locales` is `nil` and line 68 (`@loaded_locales.include?(config.locale)`) raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'include?' for nil:NilClass`.
